answer_1.quote: Our model PIECE operates on the MEMO dataset and aims to generate knowledge-enriched counseling summaries for a counseling dialogue...

answer_2.quote: We report Rouge-1 (R-1), Rouge-2 (R-2), Rouge-L (R-L), and Bleurt Score (BS)... We also evaluate using the domain‑centric metric Mental Health Information Capture (MHIC).

answer_4.quote: We present human evaluation on four standard linguistic parameters, namely relevance, consistency, fluency, and coherence as shown in Table 4. We employed 12 linguistics experts to rate each parameter on the Likert scale of 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated each summary on a Likert scale (1–5) for relevance, consistency, fluency, and coherence.
